description: Exploratory text-only stress test. All 24 cues are author-adapted or fictional. No audio, real ASR output or clinical expert labels. Synthetic timestamps of 15 seconds per cue.
glossary:
Metformin | meta formin
Hypoglycemia | hypo glycemia
Hemoglobin | haemoglobin
HbA1c | HBA1C
Milligram | miligram, miligrams
Spirometry
Bronchodilator
Nephrologist
